<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Update BVFS cache.

## Synopsis

```text
.bvfs_update [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Fills the BVFS cache in the catalog (the tables PathHierarchy and PathVisibility and the flag Job.HasCache). Without this cache .bvfs\_lsdirs and .bvfs\_lsfiles find no directories. With jobid= only the listed jobs are prepared; without it all jobs without cache are, which can take long on large catalogs. Jobs that already have a cache are skipped. Backup data is not changed.

On success nothing is printed. BVFS is kept unchanged for compatibility with Bareos tools such as bareos-webui; the OVFS commands need no cache.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | string |  |  | list | Job IDs. |
| `catalog=` | resource | from [`.catalogs`](../dot-catalogs/) |  |  | Catalog name. |

## Examples

Build the cache for one job chain:

```text
.bvfs_update jobid=600,615,616
```

Build the cache for all jobs without one:

```text
.bvfs_update
```
